modes.mode_name: OPERATING MODE 1 - NORMAL OPERATION (MAIN BILGE//MAIN FIRE)
modes.pumps: Main Bilge Pump (electric); Electric Fire Pump; Diesel Fire Pump
modes.suction_from: Seawater pickup (via seawater strainer) for fire line; Lazarette Sump, Midship Sump, Engine Room Sump, Mast Area Sump, Sail Locker Sump for bilge line
modes.discharge_to: Fire line in port sheer (fire hose stations, tender garage sprinklers) for fire operation; Bilge overboard via anti-siphon manifold (breather to run into STBD E-R vent box) for bilge operation
modes.valve_positions: These valves N.C. - only open valves necessary to remove water from relevant sump (applies at multiple sump connection points); This valve N.C. - only open valves necessary to remove water from relevant sump (single valve near B/A fire line junction)
modes.notes: Main bilge line shown in blue, main fire line shown in red. Unnecessary detail hidden for clarity in engine room area and mast area sump area.

modes.mode_name: OPERATING MODE 2 - AUXILIARY BILGE OPERATION: AUX BILGE PUMP OVERBOARD (WHEN REGULATIONS ALLOW)
modes.pumps: E-R Aux Bilge Pump; Mast Aux Bilge Pump
modes.suction_from: Engine Room Sump; Mast Area Sump
modes.discharge_to: Overboard - Fwd deck locker drain (min 800mm above DWL) via oily bilge filter and flex suction hose connection; also line to portable oil storage tank
modes.valve_positions: Not explicitly separately stated beyond flow path shown (oily bilge filter inline, flex suction hose connections shown)
modes.notes: Purple line indicates this mode's flow path. Unnecessary detail hidden for clarity.

modes.mode_name: OPERATING MODE 2 - AUXILIARY BILGE OPERATION: AUX BILGE PUMP TO STORAGE CONTAINERS
modes.pumps: E-R Aux Bilge Pump; Mast Aux Bilge Pump
modes.suction_from: Engine Room Sump; Mast Area Sump
modes.discharge_to: Portable Storage Tank(s) via oily bilge filter and flex suction hose connection; Fwd deck locker drain (below DWL) shown for reference
modes.valve_positions: Not explicitly separately stated beyond flow path shown (oily bilge filter inline, flex suction hose connections shown)
modes.notes: Purple line indicates this mode's flow path.

modes.mode_name: OPERATING MODE 3 - EMERGENCY OPERATION - FIRE BACKUP
modes.pumps: Diesel Fire Pump (electric fire pump noted as NOT OPERATIONAL)
modes.discharge_to: Fire line in port sheer (both fore and aft sections) - fire hose stations, tender garage sprinklers
modes.valve_positions: Priming line from fresh water supply ref dwg 108-01-510-001 used for priming diesel fire pump
modes.notes: Orange line indicates emergency fire backup flow path. Electric fire pump marked as NOT OPERATIONAL (red X). Unnecessary detail hidden for clarity.

modes.mode_name: OPERATING MODE 4 - EMERGENCY OPERATION - BILGE BACKUP
modes.pumps: Diesel Fire Pump (used as bilge backup, driven via priming line); Raw Water Pump (STBD Genset) (Main Bilge Pump noted as NOT OPERATIONAL)
modes.suction_from: Lazarette Sump, Midship Sump, Engine Room Sump, Mast Area Sump, Sail Locker Sump; also seachest supply ref dwg 108-01-515-003 for raw water pump
modes.discharge_to: Bilge overboard via anti-siphon manifold (breather to STBD E-R vent box); overboard via exhaust water separator ref dwg 108-01-515-001 for raw water pump
modes.valve_positions: These valves N.C. - only open valves necessary to remove water from relevant sump (multiple locations); This valve N.C. - only open valves necessary to remove water from relevant sump
modes.notes: Green line indicates emergency bilge backup flow path. Main Bilge Pump marked as NOT OPERATIONAL (red X). Unnecessary detail hidden for clarity.
